entries.name: city-sky
entries.prompt: Original art for a Japanese independent physics building-stacking game. Landscape canvas 1600x1000. Warm modern editorial city illustration, matte gouache painted paper, sunny cream sky occupying upper 70%, playful tiny distant Tokyo-inspired blue teal brick and mustard architecture at bottom 25%, construction plaza flat pale beige ground at bottom 8%. No text, no letters, no characters, no foreground crane or building, no game UI. Sophisticated architectural magazine illustration, restrained teal mustard coral palette. Flat side elevation viewpoint. Lots of empty light sky for high contrast falling building objects.

entries.name: facade-atlas
entries.prompt: Create one exact seamless-grid texture atlas for a playful architecture physics video game. Landscape 1280x512, exactly 5 columns and 2 rows, ten square 256x256 facade texture tiles filling the whole canvas, no gutters, no captions, no frame. Each tile is a FLAT FRONT ELEVATION facade material, filling its square edge to edge, not a picture of a whole building; no sky or ground. Style matte hand painted gouache paper with precise windows and tiny panels, coherent modern architectural editorial illustration. Tile row1: teal glass grid, mustard brick windows, pale blue offices, coral brick warehouse, mint concrete windows. Tile row2: navy factory metal panels, ivory art deco windows, terracotta apartment windows, lavender glass, gray industrial vents. All surfaces can be clipped into irregular building silhouettes by code. No text or logos.

entries.name: rain-city
entries.prompt: Panoramic game background 1536x768, side-on rainy Japanese neighborhood street at blue hour. Contemporary hand painted animation background, luminous amber shop windows, soft indigo concrete apartment facades, subtle muted neon reflections, fine rain haze. No readable writing, no letters, no signs, no people, no vehicles, no umbrellas. Building facades only in upper two thirds. Lower one third is a flat low contrast blue-gray wet pavement band, completely clear of objects, intended for game characters and shelter overlay shapes. Calm cozy rainy atmosphere, illustrated brushwork, polished independent game art. Flat straight-on elevation, no strong perspective vanishing point.

entries.name: night-river
entries.prompt: Original premium indie fireworks game static background, wide landscape 1536x1024. Cinematic atmospheric night photography aesthetic with delicate film grain, deep midnight navy blue sky covers top 75 percent, completely empty unclouded dark sky with very few faint stars, NO fireworks, no sparks, no smoke, no UI. Bottom quarter: small distant Japanese riverside town and a low bridge, amber windows and lanternlike tiny city lights along far bank reflected in tranquil dark river in bottom fifth. No people, no writing, no moon. Beautiful restrained blue black and warm gold palette. Clear uncluttered central sky reserved for real-time dynamic fireworks, beautifully composed quiet summer night.

entries.name: toy-workshop
entries.prompt: Original game background for a toy demolition physics puzzle, landscape 1536x1024. Warm stop-motion miniature workshop, tactile clay and balsa wood aesthetic, softly lit honey-colored wooden workbench occupies bottom 30 percent, teal pegboard and out-of-focus toy workshop shelves at side edges, center and upper center mostly clean muted sage wall behind the building puzzle. Tiny wooden blocks, spool, miniature saw decorations only at extreme left and right margins. NO central building, no people, no letters, no words, no logos, no UI, no real explosives. Straight-on front orthographic stage view with tabletop horizontal. Premium charming craft studio, warm ochre teal terracotta palette, gentle real material grain, clear open central play area.

entries.name: ice-arena
entries.prompt: Original premium curling game background texture. Portrait canvas 1024x1536. Perfect straight overhead orthographic view of a clean pale blue-white curling ice sheet, subtle tiny ice scratches and frosty pebble texture, gentle reflected diffuse overhead lights. Narrow dark blue board strips at far left and right edges, cropped sports arena ice. All central 90 percent an unobstructed ice surface. NO target rings, no painted court lines, no curling stones, no people, no text or logos or UI; game draws its own exact targets and stones. Minimal quiet Scandinavian sports photography, realistic ice material, cool steel and pale icy cyan palette, restrained contrast to make game markers very readable.

entries.name: material-atlas
entries.prompt: Original texture atlas for handmade miniature toy demolition puzzle. Landscape image 1536x512, EXACT 3 columns by 1 row equal square cells edge-to-edge no margins no gutters no labels. Flat orthographic material surfaces filling each square: first cell honey balsa wood with subtle vertical grain; second cell warm pale terracotta concrete with tiny tactile flecks; third cell muted teal painted wood with lightly worn grain. Realistic stop-motion miniature craft material aesthetic, soft even lighting, NO shadows cast across boundaries, no perspective, no building, no text or symbols. Textures will be clipped to polygonal construction parts.

entries.name: stone-atlas
entries.prompt: Transparent background sprite sheet for a quiet premium top-down curling video game. Wide landscape canvas 1024x512 with EXACTLY TWO curling stone objects centered at x256 y256 and x768 y256, each fits within 360x360 bounding box. True straight overhead orthographic view, circular gray speckled granite curling stones. Left stone has bright coral red plastic handle; right stone has deep cobalt blue plastic handle. Handles visible as elegant curved grip across top surface. Realistic softly lit sports product photography, crisp stone circular silhouettes, subtle self-shadows only, no cast shadow outside stone, isolated on fully transparent background, NO ice, no text, no words, no logos, no UI.
